Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You pull the stopper and swallow the sharp mouthful, feeling warmth return to aching limbs.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Self or one adjacent willing creature
Duration
Instant
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Universal

Requires a free hand. The giver spends the Maneuver; another recipient spends a Reaction unless at 0 HP. Restore the bottle’s printed fixed HP, apply Life resistance with minimum 1 actual healing where HP is missing, then check inventory. No outcome roll. Potions do not restore the dead or end Last Words.

Source: design/cards/use-a-healing-potion.md at bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809.
